participant_1.name: Emily Johnson
participant_1.personality: Optimistic and determined. Loves to motivate others.
participant_1.background: I'm a cancer survivor. I love running and preparing for marathons. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I am a clean eater. My parents were both very athletic.

participant_2.name: Michael Smith
participant_2.personality: Laid-back and nostalgic. Enjoys sharing stories and has a love for music.
participant_2.background: I work in the insurance business. My father is in the army. I recently was fired and had to get a new job. My mom passed away when I was young. I love playing softball.
